All three phases are implemented and verified. Here's the full status.

## Phases 1–3 complete (code + verification)

**Phase 1 — FamilyFund** (this worktree, branch `worktree-bridge-cse_…`)

**Phase 2 — dstrader** (worktree `/Users/claudio1/dev/dstrader-worktrees/ff82-auth`, branch `ff82-service-token-auth`)
- `HTTPUtils.java` (sendPost/sendGet/sendGetJson) + `HolidayAPIClient.java` now send `Authorization: Bearer`, token from `FF_API_TOKEN` env (fallback `familyfund.api_token`); properties placeholder added.
